title: Facebook Marketplace Deal Finder Input
description: Scan Facebook Marketplace by keyword and city. You must paste your own Facebook session cookies (c_user, xs, datr at minimum) because Marketplace blocks anonymous traffic. Cookies are kept inside this run only.

keywords.title: Keywords to search
keywords.description: Search queries. Each one runs against every city you list. Examples: 'iphone', 'lego star wars', 'dewalt drill'.

cities.title: City slugs
cities.description: Facebook Marketplace city slugs. The slug is the part of the URL between /marketplace/ and /search. Examples: sanfrancisco, newyork, losangeles, london, austin. Default uses sanfrancisco if left empty.

minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)
minPrice.description: Drop listings below this price. 0 keeps everything.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)
maxPrice.description: Drop listings above this price. 0 keeps everything.

daysListed.title: Posted within last N days
daysListed.description: Drop listings older than this. 0 keeps everything. Use 1 to focus on fresh deals only.

condition.title: Condition filter
condition.description: Restrict to a condition. 'any' returns everything.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max listings per keyword and city
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Cap on listings returned per (keyword, city) pair.

maxItemsTotal.title: Max listings per run
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap across all searches. Controls total cost.

scrollPasses.title: Scroll passes
scrollPasses.description: How many times to scroll each search page to load more results. Each pass typically loads another batch via GraphQL.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip listing IDs already pushed in previous runs. Turn off to track price changes on the same listing over time.

fbCookies.title: Facebook session cookies
fbCookies.description: Required. Paste your Facebook cookies from a logged in browser. Format: array of {name, value, domain}. The minimum needed are c_user, xs, and datr. Use the EditThisCookie or Cookie-Editor browser extension to export them. Cookies stay inside this run only.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is strongly recommended; Facebook flags datacenter ranges aggressively.
